# ApplyDock

ApplyDock is a local-first job application tracker. Its Python helper serves the React app and a pairing-key protected HTTP API on `http://127.0.0.1:8765`.

## Pairing

Pair in the ApplyDock app, then send the pairing key in the `X-Local-Key` header. The key stays on this computer. The full route inventory is at `/api/openapi.json`; GPT Actions should use the preparation-only schema at `/api/agent/openapi.json`. Both require the key.

## Agent commands

- `applications_list`: list applications with stable company and role identity.
- `application_get`: get compact application context.
- `analysis_run` and `analysis_summary`: queue and inspect an analysis.
- `resume_tailor`, `resume_edit`, `resume_save_and_attach`: prepare and save resume work.
- `email_preview`: prepare an email preview without sending.
- `job_status`, `job_logs`, and `job_cancel`: inspect and cancel background work.

Agents may prepare drafts and resumes. A person must approve applications and handle Gmail drafts, scheduling, and sending. Never auto-send.

## MCP

Run `py -3 -m applydock.mcp_server` with `APPLYDOCK_URL` and `APPLYDOCK_KEY` set in the environment.

## Screens

Applications, ATS Analysis, Resume Library, Resume Editor, Outreach, and Settings. Primary controls may expose stable `data-agent-id` attributes.

This API binds to the local helper. To use an HTTPS tunnel, start the helper with `APPLYDOCK_PUBLIC_URL` set to the exact tunnel origin. GPT Actions should store the pairing key as a custom `X-Local-Key` secret, never in chat instructions.
